note: Pure-CLI tool (no server/daemon), so the factory's live-auth probe is scoped out. The routing table (domains.json) is verified on every rebuild by d01; the 23 unit tests are re-run by d02; the folded front-end's own OS smoke suite (15 tests) is re-run by d03; routing accuracy over the hand-labeled 25-case fixture (replay, zero-spend, gated at 0.8) is enforced by d04; and the wilson-vault semantic index freshness (vault-check.py --fresh, zero-spend) is enforced by d05 — a stale index silently lies to every vault-grounded answer; and d06 verifies the vault-search MCP contract (manifest matches the server's tools, and the 3000/200/excludes chunking contract is identical across server.py, vault-reindex.py, and vault-check.py — AST check, zero-spend). pytest_target overrides the factory's default 'tests/' because this repo keeps its tests at the root.
